input_role: consumed development matrix; never independent holdout evidence

scope_correction.reason: Column-pruning SQL variants are EA-0 engine-mechanism controls, not alternative physical implementations emitted for one governed logical query.

unchanged_model.family: one nonnegative analytic cost formula per deployable physical candidate

decision_rule.pass_except_tail: Perform one bounded paired audit of the maximum-regret seed before adding any online probe.
decision_rule.full_pass: Freeze the deployment-scoped static model and construct a new unseen scenario matrix.
decision_rule.fail: Stop static-model iteration and move to policy-safe sampling only if the bounded audit shows a stable unmodeled effect.
